//_1_que_es: ui/_ui_defs.json registers ONLY NEW files (that don't overwrite a vanilla name). Each entry points to the file path inside the resource pack.
//_2_que_no_va_aqui: Same-key overrides do NOT go here: server_form.json, scoreboards.json, hud_screen.json, chest_screen.json, pause_screen.json go in ui/ with the vanilla name and the engine replaces them automatically.
//_3_orden: search_form is the 'custom_form' that server_form.json mounts as a control (server_form_router.json -> control_ids -> @search_form.advanced_long_form). For that @namespace.control to exist, search_form.json MUST be registered here. Without a ui_defs entry, the custom control doesn't resolve and the game silently ignores it.
